points.quote: `IDisposable` is the base interface: anything holding a resource exposes `dispose()`. `Event.on…(listener)` returns an `IDisposable`, and disposing it removes the listener.
`Disposable` is the abstract base class for most owners. A subclass calls `this._register(x)` so `x` is disposed with the owner.
`DisposableStore` is a bag of disposables. ... `toDisposable(fn)` wraps a cleanup function as an `IDisposable`.
`MutableDisposable` and `MandatoryMutableDisposable` hold one replaceable resource. Assigning a new value disposes the old one.
`ensureNoDisposablesAreLeakedInTestSuite()` in `src/vs/base/test/common/utils.ts` installs a tracker around each test and fails the test if anything leaks.
